messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — opened PR #4021 to clarify localization fallbacks and redirect guidance on the Regions page. Main points: explicitly document Accept-Language fallback to 'en' when locale unsupported, show server-side redirect examples for legacy links, and add a footnote about data residency implications. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021
DocsBot: PR opened by Maya Chen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021 (CI queued)
Samir Patel: On it. I'll review the SDK snippet for language/header handling. Quick Q: do we want to call out both Accept-Language and X-Region-Preference headers?
Maya Chen: Yes — call out Accept-Language and X-Region-Preference. We found the curl examples omitted the region header and that caused confusion in QA.
Raul Gomez: I noticed the redirect example currently uses 301. For migration guidance we should recommend 302 (temporary) unless it's a permanent change. I'll add a comment in the PR recommending 302 and rationale.
Jen O'Hara: I can run a smoke test on staging once the samples are updated. Which path should I hit?
Maya Chen: Use: /v1/region-check?path=/old-region-link. Send Accept-Language: zh-CN and X-Region-Preference: ap-southeast. Expect: 302 redirect to /regions/ap-southeast and language fallback to en if zh isn't supported. Snippets below.
Maya Chen: ```bash
curl -i -H "Accept-Language: zh-CN" -H "X-Region-Preference: ap-southeast" "https://docs.redwood.ai/v1/region-check?path=/old-region-link"
```
Maya Chen: ```js
// example fetch showing header usage in browser-based SDK shim
fetch('https://docs.redwood.ai/api/redirect', {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: { 'Accept-Language': 'fr-CA', 'X-Region-Preference': 'eu-west' }
})
  .then(r => console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('location')));
```
Raul Gomez: LGTM on the examples after I push a tiny wording tweak. Also: add a clear note that redirecting to an EU-hosted docs page does not by itself change data residency guarantees — link to the Data Residency page.
Maya Chen: Good catch. I added a footnote linking to /legal/data-residency and reworded the line to: "Redirects may change the served endpoint but do not alter contractual data residency guarantees unless explicitly configured in your account."
Samir Patel: Reviewed the SDK snippet — small nit: our SDK uses the header key 'region' in the client options mapping (not X-Region-Preference). I'll update the code sample to show both the HTTP header and the SDK config example so it's clear.
Jen O'Hara: :thumbsup: Running staging tests now. Will report results in ~10m.
Jen O'Hara: Staging results: 302 redirect ✅, language fallback to en ✅. Found two typos on the page (s/gaurd/guard/, s/behaviour/behavior). I pushed a tiny commit with fixes to the PR.
Maya Chen: Thanks! Once CI is green I'll merge. Can someone add a short release note for the docs changelog about the fallback clarification? Schedule for Monday release window.
DocsBot: PR #4021 merged by Maya Chen at 2391015800 (CI passed)
Maya Chen: Merged and changelog entry added. Thanks everyone — closing thread.
